target: Exact proposed meanings of all 41 kinds, all 263 inherited pending IDs and policies D01-D08
decision_question: For K04 applies-lesson only, does this meaning fit your intent: a Lesson Application records actual use or deliberate non-use of one exact Operational Lesson revision in an exact session, with an owned applicability assessment and instruction-precedence basis, retaining conflicts and overrides? Selection or presentation alone is insufficient, and this record alone establishes no compliance, measured benefit, authority or method use. Example: a lesson is deliberately not used because a higher-priority instruction governs the session, while benefit and compliance remain unassessed. This assesses K04 meaning only; proofs, other relations and global policies remain separate.

options.label: Accept the exact current relation as semantic owner
options.benefit: Supplies the actual new meaning assessment required before successor semantic proof work.
options.cost_risk: The reviewer must assess all scoped meanings and policy choices; this does not verify mathematical proofs or runtime behavior.
options.when: The exact meanings and policies fit the project intent and the user is the accountable semantic reviewer.
options.downstream: Record only this relation assessment. N01 remains open until every required meaning and policy assessment and artifact criterion is satisfied.

options.label: Request revisions to the current relation
options.benefit: Corrects intended-meaning or policy disagreements before proofs bind them.
options.cost_risk: Affected definitions and exact review bindings need a new version.
options.when: Any K-unit, qualifier, conclusion or D-policy has the wrong intended interpretation.
options.downstream: N01 stays open; no inherited ID is discharged.

options.label: Identify the semantic owner for the current relation
options.benefit: Places assessment with the accountable reviewer rather than inventing an assignment.
options.cost_risk: An actual assessment from that owner remains required.
options.when: The user cannot act as semantic owner for all scoped definitions.
options.downstream: Owner assignment is captured but does not itself accept the meanings.

recommended: Accept only the current exact relation if its meanings fit and the reviewer can act as its semantic owner.

source_of_requirement.plan_criterion: Each kind has an independent satisfiable meaning, exact source refinement and declared claim tier; actual assigned owners review choices and policy ambiguity.
source_of_requirement.skill_quote: Completion state may only be updated when supporting evidence exists.
source_of_requirement.decision_gate_quote: If any blocker decision remains unresolved, return BLOCK and do not proceed with consequential mutation.

consequential_work_held: N02 semantic discharge proofs under accepted meanings
independent_work_allowed: Non-accepting formal model preparation and review-response tooling within N01
review_mode: One relation at a time, followed by remaining explicit shared-policy assessments.

procedural_response.interpretation: Sequential presentation requested; no semantic acceptance or owner assignment.
